step1_analysis.description: A PMOS-based pull-up network or precharge circuit, likely part of a line driver or write driver for PRAM. It features parallel pull-up paths with variable drive strength (XM1 and XM3+XM2) and a cascode/pass device (XM4).

i_pullup_peak.description: Maximum pull-up current delivered to the load when all PMOS devices are turned on.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id_sat ≈ 0.5 * μp*Cox * (W/L) * (Vgs - |Vth|)^2. For W=5u, L=0.5u, Id_sat per branch is ~475uA. Total parallel current from VDD to N1 is ~700uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on SKY130 PMOS parameters at 1.8V supply with the given W/L ratios.

t_rise.description: Rise time of the output voltage (10% to 80% of VDD) when driving a 1pF load.

paper_reported.value: 150ns (likely refers to full write cycle time)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using the estimated peak pull-up current charging a 1pF load capacitor.

p_avg.description: Average power consumption during a switching cycle.

paper_reported.value: 4096 W (likely a parsing error for 4096 words/bytes)

sky130_expected.calculation: P_dynamic = f * C * V^2 = (1/20ns) * 1pF * 1.8^2 ≈ 162uW. Plus static dissipation through 100kΩ load ≈ 32uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sum of dynamic switching power for 1pF load and static power through the pull-down resistor.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure peak pull-up current, rise time, and average power of the PMOS driver.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for PMOS Pull-up Driver
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 N1 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N0 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 LABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_3 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Inputs for transient (active low to turn on PMOS)
VN0 N0 0 PULSE(1.8 0 2n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)
VL1 LABEL_NET_1 0 PULSE(1.8 0 2n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)
VL3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0

* Load
Cload LABEL_NET_2 0 1p
Rload LABEL_NET_2 0 100k

.control
  tran 10p 20n
  
  * Measure rise time (10% to 80% of 1.8V)
  meas tran t_rise trig v(LABEL_NET_2) val=0.18 rise=1 targ v(LABEL_NET_2) val=1.44 rise=1
  
  * Measure max voltage
  meas tran v_max max v(LABEL_NET_2)
  
  * Measure average power
  let pwr = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  meas tran p_avg avg pwr
  
  * Measure peak pull-up current (current out of VVDD is negative)
  meas tran i_peak min i(VVDD)
  let i_pullup_peak = -i_peak
  print i_pullup_peak
  
  quit
.endc
